svg.title: The published energies at each size, Hamiltonian by Hamiltonian

svg.text: The published energies at each size, Hamiltonian by Hamiltonian
The panels of the per-Hamiltonian size figures with the energy itself up the axis and nothing to measure it against. Colour is
the kind of number; filled marks can hold a record, hollow ones cannot. The line joins the record at each size.
periodic, U = 2, n = 1: 4 energies at 4 sizes

Energies per site as the table quotes them (the impurity problems in total energy); sites along x on a log scale, at the sizes the per-Hamiltonian
figures draw. Flagged rows are not shown.
